Welcome.Intro: **Mod WARNO and Steel Division 2 without the copy-paste.** Describe a change once, such as "double the range of every autocannon", and EasyNDF applies it to every matching object in the game's `.ndf` files.
Welcome.Map.Mods: Import a mod, or build your own **rules**
Welcome.YourFilesNeverLeave: Your files never leave this computer, and your originals are never changed. Export your mod to keep a copy of your rules.
Welcome.Tour.Tip: A hands-on tour of the main steps, with WARNO Tactical Overhaul and your game's own files
Welcome.ThisWindowIsOn: This window is on the Help tab.
Welcome.Tour.Start: **This tour makes a mod with you in a few steps:** pick its rules, add the game's files, preview the changes, then export. Each step asks for one thing, **in bold**, inside the outline; a dashed outline is only to look at. Left and Right arrows move through the steps.
Welcome.Tour.ModsTab: **Click the Mods tab.** Mods hold your rules: each rule describes one change, such as "double the range of every autocannon".
Welcome.Tour.PickMod: **Click {mod}** in the list. It comes with EasyNDF, as a ready-made example.
Welcome.Tour.RuleSets: Its rule sets. Each one runs on the file its name gives, such as **WTO (Ammunition.ndf)**; the rules of the one selected show at the right.
Welcome.Tour.FilesTab: **Click the Files tab.** The rules run on the files listed here.
Welcome.Tour.Source: **Pick WARNO under Source.** EasyNDF reads the game's own files, which stay as they are. No game found? End the tour, then add a GameData folder with Add Folder...
Welcome.Tour.AddItsFiles: **Click Add Its Files.** It adds the game's files that the mods that are on change. If asked, choose **Only those with rules**.
Welcome.Tour.Preview: **Click Preview.** The rules run, and nothing is saved.
Welcome.Tour.Results: Each row says what the rules did to its file. **Details**, at the right, lists every change in the file selected.
Welcome.Tour.Export: **Click Export.** The Export window shows where your files go and every file it will write. Export them, or Cancel to finish the tour.
Welcome.Tour.Done: **That's the whole loop:** rules, files, Preview, Export. Make a mod of your own with **+** on the Mods tab, and see the Help tab for more. Every window has a **?** button.
